english.note: Use 慘 as the all-purpose casual choice for being in a miserable state.
This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for something that causes great sadness or suffering.
Use this when “shocking” means extremely bad or disastrous, especially in casual speech.

examples.english: I’ve been miserable from being sick lately.
examples.jyutping: ni1 paai4 ngo5 beng6 dou3 hou2 caam2
ni1 go3 siu1 sik1 zan1 hai6 caam2

examples.english: The exam results this time are really shocking.
examples.traditional: 今次個考試成績真係慘。
examples.jyutping: gam1 ci3 go3 haau2 si3 sing4 zik1 zan1 hai6 caam2
